answer: With a Bank-verified account bound by challenge-response signature with annual re-verification, the account is only as strong as its binding: the bank-verified account answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every dawn visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. A glacier and a onyx may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
